svg.title: iOS 26.5 native observations versus the executed Sleepy core-model replay
svg.desc: First SwiftUI OFF to ON and ON to OFF taps in input order. Actual observations only; x is original frame row time relative to delivered UP. Lines disconnect across gaps over 25 milliseconds. Drawing and native local bounds may represent different layer decompositions. No GPU, optical or timing-sync acceptance.
